name: field-final-red-team-e2e-closure
objective: إثبات إغلاق Field 3 على exact latest candidate SHA فقط بعد cleanup/hardening/red-team وAndroid/cross-surface/backend/database/security/CI دون أي عيب معلوم قابل للمعالجة.
truthOwner: Latest candidate implementation/runtime/repository-platform evidence; no package text can override failing truth.

tasks.objective: Run final adversarial closure on the latest candidate and refuse DONE until zero known executable defect remains in field scope.
tasks.currentProblem: Earlier unit success can become stale after later writes and cannot by itself prove integrated runtime, cross-surface, device, security or cleanup completeness.
tasks.requiredChange: Re-pin latest head, rerun all invalidated/high-risk evidence, execute full field journeys and every related Control Panel page/tab, inspect current CI/security/runtime results, perform final cleanup/red-team, fix every discovered root defect and repeat until exhausted.
tasks.targetState: All U001-U014 outcomes coexist on one candidate; Android and required surfaces behave correctly; current CI/security/backend/database/contracts pass; no duplicate/dead/stale field path or unresolved deprecation/known defect remains.
tasks.action: Execute exact-SHA evidence matrix, intentionally attack negative/edge/race/offline/unknown-result paths, inspect diffs for cleanup, read remote checks, repair root causes, re-pin and repeat; only then update RESULT/CLOSURE to CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE.
mustNotChange: لا DONE بدليل stale أو جزئي.
لا rerun أعمى لفشل deterministic دون root fix.
لا إدخال feature غير مرتبط فقط للحصول على green.
لا ترك cleanup أو Native removal مطلوبًا دون تنفيذ.
acceptanceCriteria: جميع required unit checks PASS على evidence حديث متوافق مع final candidate.
كل صفحات/تبويبات Control Panel المرتبطة بالميداني تم اختبارها ولا تعرض/تعدل truth متناقضة.
Android real-device full journey والـoffline/native paths تمر.
current applicable CI/security/database/runtime checks خالية من blocker مرتبط.
صفر مشكلة معلومة قابلة للمعالجة داخل النطاق.
tasks.rollback: No closure rollback to weaker behavior; any discovered failure returns package to OPEN and is forward-fixed.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final evidence/bookkeeping commit only after product candidate is stable and all checks pass.
